source_text.body:
Run content marketing and TikTok posting with Claude
A commenter has Claude find social conversations, research SEO topics, write articles, generate short videos, and post TikToks every six hours hands-free.
·
Aug 27, 2026
Done with
CL
Claude
What they did
One commenter said they use Claude for marketing workflows: it browses social media to find conversations, researches SEO topics, writes articles, and generates short-form video content. A separate commenter said they run a scheduled content task that posts TikTok videos every six hours, hands-free; the thread does not explain the exact connectors, prompts, or approval steps.
How it went
The reported result was ongoing hands-free TikTok posting every six hours. The main limitation is that the thread gives almost no implementation detail, and the marketer specifically said Claude was worse at blog writing than at making TikTok videos.
Worth knowing
The catch is that this Reddit thread is very thin on setup details, so you only get the use cases and cadence, not the actual workflow configuration.
Try it yourself
with
Claude
Copy prompt
I run marketing for [my business/product], which helps [target audience] with [problem]. Find 10 recent social conversations where people are asking about [topic], research 5 SEO topics that match, and draft one article for the best topic plus a 30-second TikTok script for it. Finish with a content plan table listing each piece, its channel, and a proposed posting time every [6] hours, and pause for my approval before anything is posted or published.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/ClaudeAI/comments/1vw077k/useful_use_cases_for_automated_tasks_in_claude
